Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728

Class McpBearerChallenge

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.McpBearerChallenge
public final class McpBearerChallenge extends Object
Fluent, insertion-ordered builder for a WWW-Authenticate: Bearer ... challenge value (RFC 6750 §3, RFC 9728 §5.1) emitted by the 2026-07-28 MCP resource server on a 401.

Produces Bearer <k>="<v>", ... auth-params in the order added, so the emitted header parses cleanly on the client side via org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth.WwwAuthenticateChallenge (which lower-cases keys and accepts quoted values). Auth-param values are sanitized for the RFC 7235 quoted-string grammar: control characters (< 0x20 and 0x7F, including CR/LF that would otherwise enable header injection) are stripped, and "/\ are backslash-escaped (\" / \\) rather than mangled.

F3 extensibility:

The baseline emits realm, error, error_description, scope, and resource_metadata. The generic param(String, String) seam lets F3 (SEP-2350 scoped step-up) add further auth-params without touching this class — F2 deliberately does not implement scope-accumulation/step-up.

Since:
10.0.0
